thread:
alex: Heads up — noticed a big GPU spend jitter overnight (~$95k hit) in the billing export, looks like autoscaler thrash on the model-training pool. billing row: https://billing.example.com/rows/2243 · anyone on call?
maria (fin-ops): I see the same. Most lines are tagged as `project: experiments` but missing team-level cost_center tags — tagging dropped in the pipeline?
raj (infra): Autoscaler flapped between 02:12–02:48 (scale down/up loops). We deployed a rate-limit fix at 03:05. Will paste the k8s events and grafana window.
alex: Can we isolate the charges to the experiments cost center temporarily and then reallocate once mapping is solid? We need a clear retro plan.
li (ml-platform): We can map run metadata -> team via the run IDs, but it requires a backfill of the billing export to join on `run_id`. Backfill + validation ~2–3h. Will need read access to the raw billing rows.
maria (fin-ops): Finance policy: if mapping confidence >90% we allocate to owner teams. Otherwise put to central experiment budget and chargeback next quarter. Olivia, need sign-off on central hold.
olivia (head of finance): Approve holding to central experiment budget up to $100k this month for one-off allocation. Need a ticket, RCA, and tagging remediation plan by EOD. No repeated exceptions without infra fix.
raj (infra): Filed infra ticket #5234 with k8s events + autoscaler grafana pane: https://grafana.example.com/d/abc123/autoscaler · adding a metric/alert for scale events >10 in 1h. Also adding a small change to the HPA cooldown.
li (ml-platform): Starting backfill tonight at 23:00 UTC. Will output a CSV of `run_id,team,confidence,estimated_cost` and link it here. Command used for join: ```python backfill_billing.py --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-02 --output mapping.csv```
alex: Thanks — once we have CSV we can start allocating. Maria — can you prepare the retro allocation request template so teams can claim adjustments?
maria (fin-ops): Yep — I'll attach the allocation template and rules after the backfill. Also proposing a new alert: untagged GPU spend > $2k/day -> page #finance-oncall + owner.
finance-bot: Alert rule created: `untagged-gpu-spend` threshold $2,000/day -> notify #finance-oncall. Link: https://alerts.example.com/rules/untagged-gpu-spend
olivia (head of finance): :thumbsup: Good. Maria, include a cost impact estimate and which teams are affected in the RCA. Raj/LI — pls follow up with remediation timeline so we can close the exception.
alex: I'll coordinate comms with product owners after backfill. Will post CSV and a short allocation proposal once li finishes.
li (ml-platform): Will post results and confidence metrics here when done.
maria (fin-ops): Noted — will prepare the allocation memo and route for approval once CSV is in.
alex: thanks all.
